paper_title: ChARM Character-based Act-adaptive Reward Modeling for Advanced   Role-Playing Language Agents
caption: Results of Human Evaluations.

model_annotations.Bulgarian: The horizontal stacked bar chart presents the results of human evaluations for three language models — Claude3.5, GPT4o, and Doubao — across three outcome categories: Win, Tie, and Lose, as indicated by the legend at the bottom. The horizontal axis represents the proportion of evaluations, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0 (or 0% to 100%), with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. Each model is represented by a single horizontal bar divided into three colored segments: pink for “Win,” light blue for “Tie,” and light green for “Lose,” with the exact percentage value labeled within each segment. For Claude3.5, the segments are 32.0% Win, 44.0% Tie, and 24.0% Lose. For GPT4o, the distribution is 56.0% Win, 18.0% Tie, and 26.0% Lose. For Doubao, the values are 42.0% Win, 36.0% Tie, and 22.0% Lose. The bars are arranged vertically with model names labeled on the left, and no explicit ordering (e.g., by performance) is applied. The chart visually compares the relative proportions of each outcome across the three models, with GPT4o showing the highest Win percentage and the lowest Tie percentage among the three.
model_annotations.English: The bar chart illustrates the results of human evaluations comparing three language models—Claude3.5, GPT4o, and Doubao—across three outcome categories: Win, Tie, and Lose, as part of the ChARM framework for character-based act-adaptive reward modeling in role-playing agents. The horizontal axis represents the proportion of evaluations ranging from 0.0 to 1.0 (or 0% to 100%), while the vertical axis lists the three models. Each model’s performance is visualized as a stacked horizontal bar divided into three colored segments: pink for “Win,” light blue for “Tie,” and light green for “Lose,” with percentage values labeled within each segment. For Claude3.5, the distribution is 32.0% Win, 44.0% Tie, and 24.0% Lose. GPT4o shows 56.0% Win, 18.0% Tie, and 26.0% Lose, indicating a strong preference in human evaluations. Doubao scores 42.0% Win, 36.0% Tie, and 22.0% Lose. The chart visually emphasizes GPT4o’s higher win rate and lower tie rate compared to the others, while Claude3.5 has the highest tie rate. The legend at the bottom clearly maps the colors to the outcome categories, and all values are presented as percentages with one decimal place.
model_annotations.German: Das Balkendiagramm stellt die Ergebnisse menschlicher Bewertungen für drei verschiedene Modelle – Claude3.5, GPT4o und Doubao – dar, wobei jeder Balken in drei farbige Segmente unterteilt ist, die die Anteile von „Win“ (rosa), „Tie“ (hellblau) und „Lose“ (hellgrün) repräsentieren, wie in der Legende unten angegeben. Die horizontale Achse ist als lineare Skala von 0.0 bis 1.0 beschriftet und repräsentiert den prozentualen Anteil jeder Kategorie, wobei die Balkenlänge jeweils 1.0 entspricht. Für Claude3.5 beträgt der „Win“-Anteil 32.0 %, der „Tie“-Anteil 44.0 % und der „Lose“-Anteil 24.0 %. Bei GPT4o liegt der „Win“-Anteil bei 56.0 %, der „Tie“-Anteil bei 18.0 % und der „Lose“-Anteil bei 26.0 %. Für Doubao sind die Werte 42.0 % für „Win“, 36.0 % für „Tie“ und 22.0 % für „Lose“. Die Balken sind vertikal nach Modellnamen sortiert, ohne sichtbare Reihenfolge nach Leistung, und es gibt keine visuellen Hervorhebungen wie Schattierungen oder Umrandungen; alle Balken sind gleichmäßig gestaltet und enthalten prozentuale Werte direkt in den jeweiligen Segmenten.
